title: 餐廳點餐：過敏與特殊需求
subtitle: 12 句英文，吃得安心又不失禮

lines.say: Are you ready to order?
lines.zh: 可以點餐了嗎？

lines.say: Yes, the pesto pasta, please.
lines.zh: 可以，我要青醬義大利麵。

lines.say: Wait… is there anything in it?
lines.zh: 等等……裡面有加什麼嗎？

lines.say: My friend Aoife is allergic to nuts. She ordered pesto pasta, and she didn't know pesto is made with nuts.
lines.zh: 我朋友 Aoife 對堅果過敏。她點了青醬義大利麵，卻不知道青醬是用堅果做的。

lines.say: She was fine in the end, but she spent her birthday dinner in A and E.
lines.zh: 最後她沒事，但她的生日晚餐是在急診室度過的。

board.cta: 餐廳點餐：過敏與特殊需求・12 句

lines.say: Hi everyone, I'm Neev! Today: twelve sentences for eating out when you have an allergy, or just a preference.
lines.zh: 哈囉大家，我是 Niamh 老師！今天教你在外面吃飯時，有過敏或特別需求要用的十二句話。
lines.cap: Hi everyone, I'm Niamh! Today: twelve sentences for eating out when you have an allergy, or just a preference.

lines.say: You'll ask what's in a dish, change it, and complain politely if something goes wrong.
lines.zh: 你會學到怎麼問菜裡有什麼、怎麼請廚房調整、出錯時怎麼有禮貌地反映。

lines.say: Part one: ask first.
lines.zh: 第一段：先問清楚。

lines.say: Menus don't list everything. Sauces, oils and toppings are where the surprises hide.
lines.zh: 菜單不會寫出所有東西。醬汁、油和配料最容易藏驚喜。

scenes.label: No. 1
scenes.phrase: I have a severe nut allergy. Is that OK with this dish?
scenes.meaning: 我對堅果嚴重過敏，這道菜可以吃嗎？

lines.say: I have a severe nut allergy. Is that OK with this dish?
Severe means serious. It tells the waiter this isn't a small thing.
lines.zh: severe 是嚴重的，讓服務生知道這不是小事。

lines.say: Say it before you order, not after the food arrives.
lines.zh: 要在點餐前說，不是等菜上來才說。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: I have a severe nut allergy. Is that OK with this dish?

scenes.label: No. 2
scenes.phrase: Could you check with the kitchen what's in the sauce?
scenes.meaning: 可以幫我問一下廚房醬汁裡有什麼嗎？

lines.say: If the waiter isn't sure, don't accept a guess.
lines.zh: 如果服務生不確定，不要接受用猜的答案。

lines.say: Could you check with the kitchen what's in the sauce?
Check with the kitchen means go and ask the chef.
lines.zh: check with the kitchen 是去問廚師。

lines.say: Notice the order: what's in the sauce, not what is in the sauce is. It's a question inside a sentence.
lines.zh: 注意語序是 what's in the sauce，因為這是句子裡的問句。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: Could you check with the kitchen what's in the sauce?

scenes.label: No. 3
scenes.phrase: Is there any chance of cross-contamination?

lines.say: For real allergies, there's one more question.
lines.zh: 如果是真的過敏，還要多問一句。

lines.say: Is there any chance of cross-contamination?
Cross-contamination means a tiny amount gets in from the same pan or board.
lines.zh: cross-contamination 是同一個鍋子或砧板沾到了一點點。

lines.say: A good restaurant will give you an honest answer, even if the answer is: we can't promise.
lines.zh: 好的餐廳會老實回答，就算答案是「沒辦法保證」。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Is there any chance of cross-contamination?
Let's hear it.
lines.zh: 來聽聽看。

lines.say: I have a severe nut allergy. Is that OK with the pesto pasta?
lines.zh: 我對堅果嚴重過敏，青醬義大利麵可以吃嗎？

lines.say: Hmm, I'm not sure. Pesto usually has pine nuts.
lines.zh: 嗯，我不確定。青醬通常有松子。

lines.say: Could you check with the kitchen what's in the sauce?
lines.zh: 可以幫我問一下廚房醬汁裡有什麼嗎？

lines.say: Of course. Back in a minute.
lines.zh: 當然，馬上回來。

lines.say: Clear and calm. Now the kitchen knows too.
lines.zh: 清楚又冷靜。現在廚房也知道了。

scenes.title: Change it
scenes.sub: 請廚房調整：換、拿掉、分開放

lines.say: Part two: change it.
lines.zh: 第二段：請廚房調整。

lines.say: Not just for allergies. Maybe you don't eat meat, or you just hate onions. You're allowed to ask.
lines.zh: 不只是過敏。也許你不吃肉，或是很討厭洋蔥，都可以開口。

scenes.label: No. 4
scenes.phrase: Could I have it without the cheese?

lines.say: Could I have it without the cheese?
Without is the easiest way to remove something.
lines.zh: without 是拿掉東西最簡單的說法。

lines.say: Could I have is softer than I want. The waiter hears it all day.
lines.zh: Could I have 比 I want 柔和，服務生整天都聽到這句。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Could I have it without the cheese?

scenes.label: No. 5
scenes.phrase: Is it OK if I swap the chips for a side salad?
scenes.meaning: 薯條可以換成配菜沙拉嗎？
scenes.note: swap A for B ＝ 把 A 換成 B

lines.say: Next, a swap.
lines.zh: 接著，換菜。

lines.say: Is it OK if I swap the chips for a side salad?
Swap A for B means take A away, and give me B instead.
lines.zh: swap A for B 是拿掉 A，換成 B。

lines.say: In Ireland, chips are the thick fries. Crisps are the thin ones in a bag.
lines.zh: 在愛爾蘭，chips 是粗薯條，袋裝的薄片叫 crisps。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: Is it OK if I swap the chips for a side salad?

scenes.label: No. 6
scenes.phrase: Could I get the dressing on the side?
scenes.note: on the side ＝ 另外放、放旁邊

lines.say: And when you want control, say this.
lines.zh: 想自己控制份量時，就說這一句。

lines.say: Could I get the dressing on the side?
On the side means in a small bowl next to the food, not on it.
lines.zh: on the side 是放在旁邊的小碟子，不要淋上去。

lines.say: Then you decide how much. Very useful for sauces you don't trust.
lines.zh: 這樣份量你決定。遇到沒把握的醬汁很好用。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Could I get the dressing on the side?

scenes.title: Something's wrong
scenes.sub: 上錯菜了：說清楚但不吵架

lines.say: Part three: something's wrong.
lines.zh: 第三段：出錯了。

lines.say: The food arrives, and there's cheese all over it. What now?
lines.zh: 菜上來了，上面滿滿的起司。怎麼辦？

lines.say: Some people eat it and say nothing. Others get angry at the waiter.
lines.zh: 有些人默默吃掉，有些人對服務生發脾氣。

lines.say: Both are wrong. The waiter didn't cook it, and you shouldn't pay for food you can't eat.
lines.zh: 兩種都不對。菜不是服務生煮的，你也不該為不能吃的菜付錢。

scenes.label: No. 7
scenes.phrase: Sorry, I think there's been a mix-up. I asked for no cheese.
scenes.meaning: 不好意思，好像弄錯了，我有說不要起司

lines.say: Sorry, I think there's been a mix-up. I asked for no cheese.
A mix-up is a mistake where things got confused. It blames nobody.
lines.zh: mix-up 是搞混了，沒有怪任何人。

lines.say: Then say the fact: I asked for no cheese. Short and clear.
lines.zh: 接著講事實：I asked for no cheese。簡短清楚。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Sorry, I think there's been a mix-up. I asked for no cheese.

scenes.label: No. 8
scenes.phrase: I'm afraid I can't eat this. Could you send it back?
scenes.meaning: 恐怕我不能吃這個，可以退回廚房嗎？
scenes.note: send it back ＝ 退回去重做

lines.say: Then ask for what you need.
lines.zh: 然後說出你需要的。

lines.say: I'm afraid I can't eat this. Could you send it back?
I'm afraid is a polite way to give bad news.
lines.zh: I'm afraid 是委婉地說出壞消息。

lines.say: Send it back means return it to the kitchen to be made again.
lines.zh: send it back 是退回廚房重做。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: I'm afraid I can't eat this. Could you send it back?

scenes.label: No. 9
scenes.phrase: It's been about forty minutes. Is our food on its way?
scenes.meaning: 已經等了大概四十分鐘，我們的菜在路上了嗎？
scenes.note: on its way ＝ 在路上、快來了

lines.say: And if the food doesn't come at all?
lines.zh: 如果菜一直沒來呢？

lines.say: It's been about forty minutes. Is our food on its way?
Start with the fact: how long you've waited. Then ask a simple question.
lines.zh: 先講事實：等了多久，再問一個簡單的問題。

lines.say: On its way means it's coming soon. It sounds relaxed, but they'll understand.
lines.zh: on its way 是快來了。聽起來很輕鬆，但對方會懂。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: It's been about forty minutes. Is our food on its way?
Here you go. Enjoy!
lines.zh: 您的餐點，請慢用！

lines.say: Sorry, I think there's been a mix-up. I asked for no cheese.
lines.zh: 不好意思，好像弄錯了，我有說不要起司。

lines.say: Oh no, I'm so sorry.
lines.zh: 喔不，真的很抱歉。

lines.say: I'm afraid I can't eat this. Could you send it back?
lines.zh: 恐怕我不能吃這個，可以退回廚房嗎？

lines.say: Of course. I'll get you a fresh one straight away.
lines.zh: 當然，我馬上幫你重做一份。

lines.say: No drama, and a new plate is coming.
lines.zh: 沒有吵架，新的一盤就要來了。

lines.say: Part four: pay and go.
lines.zh: 第四段：結帳離開。

lines.say: The end of the meal has its own little phrases.
lines.zh: 吃完飯也有幾句固定的話。

scenes.label: No. 10
scenes.phrase: Could we get the bill, please?
scenes.note: the bill ＝ 帳單（美國說 the check）

lines.say: Could we get the bill, please?
In Ireland and the UK, we say the bill. Americans say the check.
lines.zh: 在愛爾蘭和英國說 the bill，美國人說 the check。

lines.say: And the waiter usually won't bring it until you ask. That's not slow service. It's politeness.
lines.zh: 而且你不開口，服務生通常不會拿來。那不是服務慢，是禮貌。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Could we get the bill, please?

scenes.label: No. 11
scenes.phrase: Would it be OK to split it three ways?
scenes.note: split it three ways ＝ 平分成三份

lines.say: Eating with friends? Ask this.
lines.zh: 跟朋友一起吃？問這一句。

lines.say: Would it be OK to split it three ways?
Split it means divide it. Three ways means into three equal parts.
lines.zh: split 是分開，three ways 是平均分成三份。

lines.say: Or say: could we pay separately? Then everyone pays for their own food.
lines.zh: 或是說 could we pay separately，各付各的。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: Would it be OK to split it three ways?

scenes.label: No. 12
scenes.phrase: Thanks, that was lovely. Please pass it on to the chef.
scenes.meaning: 謝謝，非常好吃，請幫我轉告廚師

lines.say: And finish with a compliment.
lines.zh: 最後送上一句稱讚。

lines.say: Thanks, that was lovely. Please pass it on to the chef.
Pass it on means tell someone else for me.
lines.zh: pass it on 是幫我轉達給別人。

lines.say: Tipping is not required in Ireland, but about ten percent is normal for good service.
lines.zh: 在愛爾蘭小費不是必須的，但服務好的話給一成左右很常見。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Thanks, that was lovely. Please pass it on to the chef.

scenes.title: Only in Ireland
scenes.sub: 愛爾蘭限定：吃飯時聽到的兩句

lines.say: One more thing! Two things you'll hear at an Irish table.
lines.zh: 還有加碼！在愛爾蘭餐桌上會聽到的兩句話。

lines.say: Irish people use gorgeous for food, not only for people.
lines.zh: 愛爾蘭人 gorgeous 不只形容人，也形容食物。

lines.say: That was gorgeous!
So if your Irish friend says the soup was gorgeous, it was really, really good.
lines.zh: 所以愛爾蘭朋友說湯 gorgeous，就是超級好喝。

board.kicker: When you can't eat any more

lines.say: And at the end of a big meal, you'll hear this.
lines.zh: 大餐吃完之後，你會聽到這句。

lines.say: I'm stuffed.
Stuffed means so full you can't move. Then someone will still offer you dessert!
lines.zh: stuffed 是飽到動不了。然後還是會有人問你要不要甜點！

lines.say: I'm stuffed!

scenes.title: All together
scenes.sub: 總複習：一頓安心的晚餐

lines.say: Let's have that dinner again, the safe way. Say my lines with me!
lines.zh: 我們再吃一次這頓晚餐，這次很安心。跟我一起唸！

lines.say: Are you ready to order?
lines.zh: 可以點餐了嗎？

lines.say: I have a severe nut allergy. Is that OK with this dish?
lines.zh: 我對堅果嚴重過敏，這道菜可以吃嗎？

lines.say: That one's fine. No nuts at all.
lines.zh: 這道沒問題，完全沒有堅果。

lines.say: Great. Could I have it without the cheese, and the dressing on the side?
lines.zh: 太好了。可以不要加起司，醬汁另外放嗎？

lines.say: No problem.
lines.zh: 沒問題。

lines.say: Thanks, that was lovely. Could we get the bill, please?
lines.zh: 謝謝，非常好吃。可以幫我們結帳嗎？

items: I have a severe nut allergy. Is that OK with this dish?
Could you check with the kitchen what's in the sauce?
Is there any chance of cross-contamination?
Could I have it without the cheese?
Is it OK if I swap the chips for a side salad?
Could I get the dressing on the side?
Sorry, I think there's been a mix-up. I asked for no cheese.
I'm afraid I can't eat this. Could you send it back?
It's been about forty minutes. Is our food on its way?
Could we get the bill, please?
Would it be OK to split it three ways?
Thanks, that was lovely. Please pass it on to the chef.

lines.say: Safe, full, and happy. Well done!
lines.zh: 吃得安心、吃得飽，也很開心。做得好！

lines.say: Here are all twelve. Take a screenshot before you eat out.
lines.zh: 十二句都在這裡，出去吃飯前先截圖。

board.cta: 打開 BinBin，每天用一則新聞練英文

lines.say: I'm Neev. Open BinBin, and practise English with one news story every day.
lines.zh: 我是 Niamh 老師。打開 BinBin，每天用一則新聞練英文。
lines.cap: I'm Niamh. Open BinBin, and practise English with one news story every day.

lines.say: And Aoife? She orders the pesto every time now. Without the pesto. Bye!
lines.zh: 那 Aoife 呢？她現在每次都點青醬麵，不加青醬。Bye！
